The description does not mention the left y-axis range (0–400 billion US dollars) or the right y-axis range (-200 to 400 billion US dollars).
The description does not mention the legend, which identifies the blue line as 'Importe,' the red line as 'Exporte,' and the blue bars as 'Saldo.'

The description does not mention the downward orientation of the blue bars (Saldo) or their increasing length over time.
The phrase 'stellt die Zollwertung figurative dar' is unclear and does not correspond to any visible feature in the chart.
